messages:
Lee: @channel need to provision a private GPU node pool in europe-west3 for Acme trial. Requirements: no external IPs, forced egress via customer proxy (172.16.5.1), private GKE cluster, A100 preferred but quota limited. Any objections?
Sam: OK—what size? expected pods and qps?
Lee: initial canary: 2 nodes (n1-standard-32, 1xA100 each) for low-latency batch. Plan to scale to ~20 nodes peak. Autoscaler should respect pod priority and scale-down delay 15m.
Anya: we need nodeSubnet with secondary IP ranges for pods, and firewall rules to allow egress to the proxy. Also no public IPs -> use Cloud NAT in the VPC. I'll open a quota request for A100 + internal IP ranges.
Rashid: what about using A10G preemptible for cost—would save ~60% but evictions might impact the trial.
Lee: Trial needs reliability; prefer on-demand A100. If quota denied we'll fallback to an A10G pool and adjust our scheduler and retry logic.
Sam: @Anya can you paste a terraform snippet for nodepool taints + noPublicIp? I'll reuse it in the infra repo.
Anya: here's a rough tf snippet for the node pool config (trimmed):
```hcl
resource "google_container_node_pool" "private_gpu" {
  name = "private-gpu"
  node_config {
    machine_type = "n1-standard-32"
    accelerators { type = "nvidia-a100" count = 1 }
    metadata = { disable-legacy-endpoints = "true" }
    tags = ["private-gpu"]
    image_type = "COS_CONTAINERD"
    # ensure no external IPs via private_ip_google_access + NAT setup
  }
  initial_node_count = 2
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 2 max_node_count = 20 }
  management { auto_repair = true }
}
```
Sam: small nit: add taints = ["gpu=true:NoSchedule"] and labels like "pool=gpu-private" for routing/provisioner.
Rashid: Also ensure GPU device-plugin DaemonSet tolerations and an init container to install drivers on boot if not using cos-driver image. Verify node image supports MIG if we later want partitioning.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-3278 to request A100 quota in europe-west3 and opened a NAT request in VPC-ops. ETA ~2 business days.
Billing-bot: rough cost estimate: 2x A100 on-demand ~= $9k/month baseline. Peak 20 nodes ~= $90k/month. A10G preemptible peak ~= $35k/month. These are ballpark — will need exact SKUs and sustained usage to refine.
Lee: Next steps: Anya opens quota + NAT + firewall request, Sam will add taints/labels + CA config, I'll prepare canary manifests (2 pods) and a rollout plan. We should also add a healthcheck for GPU driver readiness.
Sam: I'll set cluster-autoscaler config: expander: priority, balance-similar-node-groups: false, scaleDownUnneededTime: 15m, and configure scale-up for single-GPU pods to prefer binpacking.
Anya: noted. I'll also request a VPC-SC exception for the proxy route and ensure the subnet has secondary ranges for pod IPs.
Lee: lgtm :thumbsup:
summary: Private GPU node pool request for europe-west3 with A100 preference, no external IPs, Cloud NAT egress to customer proxy, autoscaler settings, taints/labels, quota and cost discussion.
